annotations.title: ENS and Basenames resolver (forward and reverse)

description: ENS and Basenames lookup: name to address, or address to primary name with forward verification. Returns the ETH address, resolver contract, text records (url, avatar, description, Twitter, GitHub, Telegram, and email when set on-chain) and decoded contenthash (IPFS, IPNS, Swarm, Arweave). Sources: ENS Universal Resolver on Ethereum and the Basenames registry on Base, read via PublicNode JSON-RPC; offchain (CCIP-read) names are reported, not followed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: 0x EVM address for a reverse lookup: its primary name on Ethereum (ENS) and Base (Basenames), checked by forward resolution, plus that name's records.

name.description: ASCII ENS name (vitalik.eth) or Basename (jesse.base.eth) for a forward lookup. Mutually exclusive with address.
